title: VU#124705: BaseChat – Audio Dating App, Android version 9.8.1, contains multiple vulnerabilities
description: Multiple vulnerabilities have been identified in BaseChat – Audio Dating App, Android version 9.8.1, compromising user privacy and security. The app fails to properly validate TLS server certificates, allowing any self-signed certificate to bypass security checks. Paid user accounts are linked to a third-party RevenueCat subscriber database using raw phone numbers, which can be queried via a public API key embedded in the app. Additionally, the app logs personally identifiable information, including phone numbers of callers, to Android system logs, exposing private data. These issues enable interception and modification of API communication, unauthorized access to user metadata, and leakage of private phone numbers through logs. The vendor has not responded to coordinate remediation.
